summary: Verified asset fix + full regression. All 6 store assets have correct dimensions, mode=RGB, no alpha. Adaptive-icon and main icon have 100% uniform #0A1128 border (all 4 corners == (10,17,40); every pixel in the outer 20-px ring is (10,17,40) with zero unique variants) — inner-square outline / near-white halo artifacts are gone. Visual preview confirms gold sun mandala + crescent + lotus is centered inside 65% safe zone (adaptive) / 86% canvas (icon). app.json declares correct name, versionCode, package, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, adaptive icon paths, privacyPolicyUrl. GET /api/privacy → 200 with 'ManaLife Calendar', 'Privacy Policy', 'offline', 'do not collect'. App boots at 390x844, all 5 bottom tabs render & tappable, every iteration_3 testID present, sunrise=5:47 AM Hyderabad, language switch en↔te works (Saptami → సప్తమి), Ionicons render from local bundle, no red-screen / no console errors (only harmless expo-notifications web-warning and pointerEvents deprecation).

react_native_issues.issue: adaptiveIcon.backgroundColor is '#060B19' but the foreground PNG is baked onto '#0A1128'. Two-value difference (~4 units per channel) is invisible in practice because the foreground fills the entire 1024x1024 canvas — however for perfect consistency, set adaptiveIcon.backgroundColor to '#0A1128'. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json:35

monochromeImage points to the same colored adaptive-icon.png. Android themed-icon spec expects a monochrome silhouette (alpha only). Not a launch blocker (Android will still tint & use it), but themed icon will look flat. Consider generating a proper alpha-only silhouette PNG. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json:36

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic, not launch-blocking): change android.adaptiveIcon.backgroundColor in /app/frontend/app.json from '#060B19' to '#0A1128' to match the foreground fill exactly.
OPTIONAL (Android 13+ themed icon quality): generate a true monochrome silhouette (alpha only) PNG for android.adaptiveIcon.monochromeImage instead of reusing the colored adaptive-icon.png.
READY to proceed with EAS AAB build — asset & metadata verification passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly serves /api/privacy via FileResponse; CORS is a strict allow-list (no wildcard) — good production posture.

process_assets.py uses a well-defined color-key mask ((R+G)-2B>55, brightness gates) plus explicit neutralization of near-white border pixels (alpha=0) — this is why the corner/border pixel test yields exactly one unique color (10,17,40).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Assets and privacy policy are production-ready. Two OPTIONAL cosmetic tweaks are noted but do not block the AAB build. When main agent triggers `eas build --platform android --profile production`, monitor for any Gradle warnings on adaptiveIcon.backgroundColor mismatch — they will be non-fatal.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (light inner-square artifact around adaptive icon) was caused by the source AI image having a near-white anti-alias halo where the gold emblem met its own navy inset. The new /app/scripts/process_assets.py extracts gold pixels by warm-color mask (goldness = (R+G) - 2B > 55) and explicitly sets alpha=0 on all near-white pixels (`(goldness<20) & (R>200)`), then composites onto a fresh, single-value #0A1128 canvas. Verification: outer-20px border of both icon.png and adaptive-icon.png contains exactly ONE unique RGB value (10,17,40) across 81,920 pixels each — confirming the artifact is fully eliminated.
